content: In this paper, all experiments were carried out on a machine running Windows 7 with CoreI3 and 4 GB memory. We learn a LDA model with 100 topics; $\alpha =0.01$, $\beta = 0.01$ and using Gibbs sampling as a parameter estimation. Related words for a topic are quite intuitive and comprehensive in the sense of supplying a semantic short of a specific research field.
